description: Status of a generation job; result_url is set when status is "completed". Set wait_seconds to keep polling until the job finishes or the time is up. Failed jobs are refunded automatically.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a generate call, e.g. "j_abc123def456"

wait_seconds.description: Poll for up to this many seconds (default 0: return at once; at most 50, call again for longer jobs)

name: get_job
title: Get job
